# Houston Superior Painting — Professional painting services in Greater Houston, TX

> Houston Superior Painting is a fully insured painting contractor founded in 2019
> by Juan Serra, serving Houston, Katy, Cypress, Sugar Land, Richmond, Fulshear, Pearland,
> Memorial, The Heights, Bellaire, and The Woodlands TX. We specialize in interior painting,
> exterior painting, cabinet refinishing, drywall repair, pressure washing, limewash, brick
> painting, and load-bearing wall removal. 5-year exterior warranty.
> Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore certified.

## About

## FAQ
Q: How much does it cost to paint a house in Houston?
A: Interior painting costs $2.50–$4.50 per sq ft. Exterior painting costs $3.00–$5.50 per sq ft. A typical 2,500 sq ft home interior costs $4,000–$8,000.

Q: How long does exterior paint last in Houston?
A: With proper preparation and premium coatings, exterior paint lasts 8–10 years in Houston's climate.

Q: Do you offer cabinet painting?
A: Yes. Houston Superior Painting offers professional cabinet refinishing with factory-finish spray techniques. Projects cost $3,000–$8,000 and include a 5-year warranty.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve Houston, Katy, Cypress, Sugar Land, Richmond, Fulshear, Pearland, Memorial, The Heights, Bellaire, The Woodlands, and surrounding areas.
